BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to archery hunting; and adding a new section tochapter 77.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person who is otherwise qualified by law to carry a firearm maycarry or have in his or her possession such a firearm, including amuzzle loader, while in the field archery hunting during an archeryseason specified for a designated area.
